description: Get a live or completed auction's bid history using its ID from search_auctions or search_live_auctions. Returns bidder names, bid amounts, and times where captured. Requires login and counts toward the plan allowance. Coverage varies by source.

auction_id.description: Auction ID returned by search_auctions, list_live_auctions, or search_live_auctions

bid_after.description: Only include bids placed at or after this ISO datetime

bid_before.description: Only include bids placed at or before this ISO datetime

name: get_auction_bids
